meta.source: The build framework's default tokens (formerly templates/project/src/styles/tokens.css), in the Claude Design System token format. No brand: system fonts, one blue accent, light and dark.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The page. Every screen starts here.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised panels, cards and table stripes; carries text and text-muted.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on bg and surface.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, captions and helper text on bg and surface; still 4.5:1.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers and card outlines. Decorative: a control's own boundary or state needs 3:1 or a label.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary buttons (fill), links and selected states; also readable as text on bg.

tokens.name: accent-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill. Flips with the theme because the dark accent is light.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and destructive button fills. Always with a word or an icon.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, at least 3:1 against the page.

families.sans: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title, one per page. Steps down to 28px below 768px.

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: Metadata and helper text in text-muted.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: A card that floats over the page. Prefer a surface change and a border.
